_note: Sources for the sports wire.
This is a feed on the industry, not on the games. Results, fixtures,
transfers, previews, player ratings and medal tables are refused by the gate
- that is nearly all sports coverage, and none of it is the subject.
The animal racing and rodeo subject comes from the animal-industries section
of the page rather than the sports section, which labels it 'Animal Racing
and Other Animal Sports'. It is carried here because it is the same activity.
direct: feeds proven working in the sibling Welcome to Your Galaxy repos.
Nothing invented - an untested feed URL reports itself unreachable on every
harvest and quietly makes the coverage figure a lie.
As with the science and entertainment wires, the direct list is uneven for
this subject. The rights and anti-corruption feeds carry the labour,
mega-event and governance half well. Nothing here covers sports integrity,
doping or club finance directly, so the events block carries that half.
gnews: Google News locale searches; the harvester builds the URL from
hl / gl / ceid. Twenty-four queries rotate across 46 locales.
events: subject searches for integrity units, regulators, courts and research.
standing is provenance, not importance:
official  regulators, courts, governing bodies, anti-doping agencies
research  integrity, concentration, health and cost research
press     general news across the locales
rights    athlete, fan and animal welfare organisations
Add next, with URLs you have opened: Play the Game, Sport Resolutions, the
Sports Integrity Initiative, WADA, the Court of Arbitration for Sport, FIFPRO,
the World Players Association, Animal Aid's racing deaths tracker, and Grey2K.
